stories.title: Traffic backed up for miles after semi rolls over on I-80/94 in NW Indiana
stories.summary: Traffic backed up for miles after a semi-truck rolled over on Interstate 80/94 in Lake Station, Ind., during rush hour on a major holiday travel day, video showed. Around 4:14 p.m., a crash between two semi-trucks caused one to roll over in the westbound lanes of I-80/94 near Rip
